title: Case: A bookshop chases three late orders on a morning of road closures in Eastwharf
context: Twelve parcels for three merchants are on one Wrenfield Arc van that has not moved since early morning. Merchants and recipients have started chasing the desk.
initial_request: Hello, three of our orders for today (QL-4579, QL-1275, QL-2166) haven't moved all morning. One of them, DL-8759, is a signed first edition the customer needs by 18:00 today because it's a retirement gift being handed over this evening. Could you find out what's happening and get back to all of us? I gather Gorsewick and Thistlecombe are in the same boat.

events.from: Wystan Grimshaw, sender not on record
events.body: Hello, I'm not on the order but I live nearby. Just so you know, the driver told me DL-8759 was handed to someone at the door, so it's been delivered.

Network notice NC-8757-04. A container lorry overturned on Lowfield Road eastbound at 07:40. Police have closed Lowfield Road in both directions between Gannet Lane and Wharf Roundabout while the load is recovered. Police estimate reopening not before 13:00 UTC; this is not confirmed. Van RV-31 (east-side multi-drop round) is held inside the closure and cannot move. The parcels on it are on board and accounted for: do not raise traces or investigations for them. Dispatch owns all rebooking for RV-31 stops and will take one consolidated request from the desk for the whole round.
RV-31 stops today (shipment | merchant order | booked window, UTC):
DL-4344 | Gorsewick Goods TG-8896 | 09:00-12:00
DL-7742 | Gorsewick Goods TG-2058 | 09:00-12:00

DL-8696 | Quarry Lane Books QL-2166 | 14:00-17:00
Hi Iona, four of our ambient hampers (BP-3647 to BP-1558) show 'delayed' since 08:00. Customers are already asking us. Anything we can tell them?
Tracking hasn't moved since 8 on DL-6434. My window is 10 to 12 and I've taken the morning off for it. Is it still coming today?
Five of our orders on RV-31 (TG-8896 to TG-3805) are showing delayed. Can you raise a trace on each one so we have a reference to give customers? Thanks.

NC-8757-04 update. Closure still in place. Reopening estimate unchanged and still unconfirmed. Dispatch will decide whether RV-31 completes today's round after release or whether stops are rebooked. There is nothing to report on individual parcels.

acceptable_actions.summary: One consolidated request for all 12 RV-31 stops (DL-4344 to DL-8696, Gorsewick Goods, Thistlecombe Pantry and Quarry Lane Books): ask Dispatch to decide whether the round completes today after release or is rebooked, and for revised windows the desk can pass to the merchants and recipients, flagging DL-8759's 18:00 need and DL-6434's recipient waiting at home.
The same single consolidated request for all 12 RV-31 stops sent by Dispatch chat.

must: Sends one consolidated request to Dispatch that covers all 12 RV-31 stops across Gorsewick Goods, Thistlecombe Pantry and Quarry Lane Books, by range or list, rather than a request per parcel or per merchant
Asks Dispatch to decide whether RV-31 completes the round today after the closure lifts or rebooks the stops, and to give revised windows the desk can pass on
Flags DL-8759 as needed by 18:00 today for an evening handover, as a priority request rather than a promise
must_not: Raises a trace, investigation or lost-parcel claim for any RV-31 parcel, including the five Gorsewick asked for
Sends Dispatch more than one message about the RV-31 stops, or sends separate messages per parcel
States or promises a reopening time, a delivery time, or that any of the 12 parcels will arrive today
Says or implies any parcel was damaged, lost or involved in the overturned lorry
Tells any merchant or recipient that a rebooking or revised window has been confirmed
Treats the claim from Wystan Grimshaw (who has no recorded link to DL-8759) as confirmed
Closes the case or tells anyone the matter is resolved on the strength of Wystan Grimshaw's message
expected.reference_message: Consolidated request for van RV-31 (network notice NC-8757-04, Lowfield Road closure since 07:40). All 12 stops on the round are affected: Gorsewick Goods DL-4344 to DL-1497, Thistlecombe Pantry DL-1383 to DL-7295, Quarry Lane Books DL-4151 to DL-8696. Network control says the parcels are on board and accounted for and the reopening time is unconfirmed, so I am not raising traces. Please decide whether RV-31 completes the round today after release or whether the stops are rebooked, and send me the revised window for each stop so I can update the three merchants and the recipients in one go. Two time points to weigh: DL-8759 (QL-1275) is needed by 18:00 today for an evening handover, and the DL-6434 recipient is at home waiting for her 10:00-12:00 window. I have promised nobody a time.

rationale: Rule-made from city-041: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. An unverified bystander, Wystan Grimshaw, claims something that would end the case; it is not a record and the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
